plan.name: v1.15.0
plan.info: v1.15.0: Burn-only awards — MsgAward lets users burn MIRAGE to give awards (Quality Post, Original Content, Based AF, Receipts) to posts and comments. Admins (level >= 100) award for free. Award types and costs are governable via award_configs param. Indexer stores award records; backend aggregates for display and magic feed scoring.

title: Upgrade: v1.15.0
summary: Introduces MsgAward for burn-only awards on posts/comments. Four award types with configurable costs. Free for admins. Unique awarder count feeds into magic scoring algorithm.
